title: SKE Crystal Pro Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods provide a seamless and efficient way to enjoy outstanding flavour and satisfaction without the waste and cost of single-use disposables. Each prefilled pod offers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw with fast-acting nicotine relief. Cherry Ice delivers the deep, juicy flavour of ripe cherries, perfectly balanced with a subtle tartness that enhances the fruit’s natural richness. A crisp menthol finish lifts the flavour, creating a cool and refreshing exhale that leaves a lingering, fruity chill. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—simply remove the empty pod and click a fresh one into place. Whether you're looking for a more cost-effective alternative to disposables or a convenient way to enjoy your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide a mess-free and satisfying solution.
